thread:
maya: Morning check-in — queue is heavier than usual, ~33 tickets open, 3 flagged P1s, surge on billing reports. Not seeing refunds initiated yet. Can someone pick up investigation?

triage-bot: Queue snapshot: open=33, P1=3, avg-response=22m, recent-tag=billing-dup. Auto-attach: s3://redwood-support/logs/billing/2026-03-17/04-18/*.gz

ashwin: Ill take the P1s and start correlating logs. Initial look shows multiple charges for same invoice id within 90s window. Will post patterns. :mag:

maya: symptom summary: payment gateway reports single successful auth, then another charge with same invoice_id appears shortly after. No automated refunds observed in the tickets.

leo: Is this limited to a rollout group or global? Any worker version info in logs?

ashwin: Early markers point to billing-service v2 rolling traffic. Example sanitized log snippet: 

```
POST /api/v2/charge
payload: {\"invoice_id\":\"inv_Zt9\", \"amount\":4500}
-> 200 {\"charge_id\":\"ch_X1\"}
... 85s later ...
POST /api/v2/charge
payload: {\"invoice_id\":\"inv_Zt9\", \"amount\":4500}
-> 200 {\"charge_id\":\"ch_X2\"}
```

sam: I reproduced locally by forcing a timeout between worker and gateway; the worker retry code issues a fresh POST without preserving idempotency key on retry. Looks like v2 changed the retry path.

maya: action items: (1) create/update customer-facing macro for CS replies, (2) collect affected account list for pre-approval of refunds, (3) small hotfix to ensure idempotency header persisted across retry.

daria: for the macro, add a clear refund SLA and next steps so CS can close tickets with confidence. Suggest: "If duplicate confirmed, refund will be processed within 24 hours."

maya: good call, will include that. Also @finops please stand by for account list and pre-authorization.

finops: standing by. Please send final account matrix once available.

ashwin: compiling list now. Will open a PR with tiny patch to retry path: copy X-Idempotency-Key from original attempt into retry metadata. PR link when ready.

leo: ping me on PR for quick review. If tests pass, we can deploy to canary and monitor for 30m before broader rollout.

sam: staging curl to repro (use on staging only):

```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.billing.redwood/api/charge \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_stress","amount":1}'
# induce a delayed response on gateway to trigger retry
```

triage-bot: Incident tag created -> INC-2026-03-17-BILL-01. Pager suppressed; on-call and finance alerted.

maya: macro draft below. I'll upload to KB and request CS use it when replying. Keep updates concise here.

```
Macro: billing-possible-duplicate
--
Hi {first_name},

Thanks for the report. Were actively investigating a possible duplicate charge for invoice {invoice_id}. To help us resolve quickly, please confirm the following if available:
\u2022 customer id: {customer_id}
\u2022 invoice id: {invoice_id}
\u2022 first charge id and timestamp: {charge_id_1} ({ts_1})
\u2022 second/duplicate charge id and timestamp: {charge_id_2} ({ts_2})

If we confirm a duplicate charge, a refund will be initiated and typically completed within 24 hours. We will follow up here with confirmation and ETA.

Tags: billing, billing-duplicate, urgent
```

ashwin: 04:35 UTC update  first 5 customers confirmed duplicates, refund path validated on staging. PR: https://git.redwood/eng/billing/pulls/418 rolled to canary.

sam: Canary looks stable after 25m. No additional duplicates observed there. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks team. CS will use macro and schedule refunds. Closing this thread after final confirmation; post any new anomalies here as quick bullets only.
